Card Q&A.a: No. You don't have any security cards to trash, so you can't activate this effect.
Card Q&A.q: If I have no cards left in my security stack, can I use this card's [On Play] effect to decrease the DP of 1 of my opponent's Digimon by 2000?

Effect: [On Play] You may trash the top card of your security stack to have 1 of your opponent's Digimon get -2000 DP for the turn.
